items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: What was Speedy doing when you met her? ... That was her stage name, Violet Speedy, but her original name was Lillian Sherman.

ctx.x: What was Speedy doing when you met her? Was she in a show, or what?
No, she was -- let me back up awhile. That was her stage name, Violet Speedy, but her original name was Lillian Sherman.
